title: Orca 2: Teaching Small Language Models How to Reason
authors_zh: Arindam Mitra, Luciano Del Corro, Shweti Mahajan, Andres Codas, Clarisse Simoes, Sahaj Agarwal, Xuxi Chen, Anastasia Razdaibiedina, Erik Jones, Kriti Aggarwal, Hamid Palangi, Guoqing Zheng, Corby Rosset, Hamed Khanpour, Ahmed Awadallah
best_for_zh: 适合为小模型设计 teacher 生成推理示范的读者。
one_line: Orca 2 elicits task-specific reasoning strategies from GPT-4 and erases the strategy prompt during SFT so a smaller model learns both how and when to reason.
Orca 2 让 GPT-4 按任务生成不同策略的推理回答，并在 SFT 时擦除策略提示，使小模型同时学习怎样推理和何时采用哪种策略。
why: It changes teacher imitation from copying one response style to training on strategy-tailored answer traces.
inclusion_reason: Orca 2 turns task-specific teacher reasoning strategies into student-visible answer traces while withholding the strategy prompt, so strategy choice must be learned from the task.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Teacher distillation often asks a small model to imitate whatever answer a stronger model gives. That can teach surface style without teaching which reasoning strategy fits a task, and a strategy that is effortless for GPT-4 may be unsuitable for a 7B or 13B student.

Orca 2 addresses this by choosing task-specific strategies—direct answer, step-by-step, recall-then-generate, recall-reason-generate, and others—using detailed prompts to elicit suitable GPT-4 responses, then erasing those strategy prompts during student training. The direct data object is a task paired with a strategy-shaped answer trace; 817K new records join FLAN and Orca 1 data in progressive SFT. Primary source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.11045; no formal venue beyond arXiv was confirmed.

教师蒸馏通常让小模型模仿强模型给出的任何回答。这可能只教会表面风格，却没有教会哪种推理策略适合当前任务；对 GPT-4 很轻松的策略，也可能不适合 7B 或 13B 的 student。

Orca 2 先按任务选择直接回答、逐步推理、先回忆再生成、先回忆推理再生成等策略，用详细 prompt 诱导 GPT-4 产出合适回答，再在 student 训练时擦除这些策略 prompt。直接数据对象是任务与经过策略塑形的回答轨迹；817K 条新记录与 FLAN、Orca 1 数据一起用于渐进式 SFT。官方来源：https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.11045；未确认 arXiv 之外的正式会议。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Orca 2 changes teacher imitation from copying one generic style to supervising task-conditioned strategy behavior: authors select a strategy, GPT-4 writes the corresponding answer trace, and Prompt Erasing removes the strategy instruction so SFT must learn both the behavior and when to invoke it. Compared with Orca 1's general explanation tuning, the closest change is the hidden task-strategy decision rather than a new optimizer.

Google Scholar citations: 259（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=Orca+2%3A+Teaching+Small+Language+Models+How+to+Reason&author=Arindam+Mitra&hl=en）

Open dataset: no. The paper describes approximately 817K new Orca 2 training instances, but does not release those records, their file format, or a dataset license. The official entry at https://aka.ms/orca-lm provides model weights; weights are not a substitute for the underlying task-prompt-answer dataset.

Orca 2 把教师模仿从复制一种通用风格，改成监督“按任务选择策略”的行为：作者先选策略，GPT-4 编写相应回答轨迹，再用 Prompt Erasing 删除策略说明，使 SFT 必须同时学习具体行为和何时调用它。相对 Orca 1 的通用 explanation tuning，最接近的变化是隐藏的任务—策略决策，而不是新的 optimizer。

Google Scholar 引用数：259（查询于 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=Orca+2%3A+Teaching+Small+Language+Models+How+to+Reason&author=Arindam+Mitra&hl=en）

开源数据：没有。论文描述了约 817K 条新的 Orca 2 训练记录，但没有发布这些记录、文件格式或数据集许可证。官方入口 https://aka.ms/orca-lm 提供模型权重；权重不能替代底层的任务—prompt—回答数据。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Group tasks and inspect failures. Input FLAN/Orca task families and earlier Orca behavior; identify where a small model needs direct answering, step-by-step reasoning, recall, extraction, or another strategy. Output a task-to-strategy mapping chosen for the student's capacity.
  2. Write teacher prompts. For each task group, create detailed system instructions that elicit the selected behavior from GPT-4; multiple calls or specialized prompts may be used. Output task, strategy prompt, and teacher answer triplets.
  3. Erase the strategy. Replace the detailed generation prompt with a generic system message before student training, leaving the user task and GPT-4 answer trace visible. The student therefore cannot simply condition on an explicit “use strategy X” label.
  4. Train progressively. Starting from LLaMA-2-7B or 13B, train one epoch on FLAN-v2, three epochs on 5M GPT-3.5 teacher records from Orca 1, then four epochs on about 1M GPT-4 Orca 1 records plus 817K Orca 2 records. Output the Orca-2-7B and 13B checkpoints.
  5. Evaluate the learned choice. Run zero-shot evaluations over 15 benchmarks, about 100 tasks, and more than 36K prompts, using exact-match or task-specific metrics plus open-ended judges where needed. The results test model behavior; without released records they do not independently verify the hidden data-selection decisions.

1. 划分任务并检查失败。 输入 FLAN/Orca 任务族和早期 Orca 行为，判断小模型在什么任务上需要直接回答、逐步推理、回忆、抽取或其它策略，产出按 student 容量选择的任务—策略映射。
  2. 编写 teacher prompt。 为每个任务组设计详细 system instruction，诱导 GPT-4 产生指定行为；必要时可多次调用或使用专用 prompt，产出“任务—策略提示—teacher 回答”三元组。
  3. 擦除策略。 student 训练前，把详细生成 prompt 替换成通用 system message，只保留用户任务与 GPT-4 回答轨迹；因此 student 不能仅靠显式的“使用策略 X”标签作答。
  4. 渐进式训练。 从 LLaMA-2-7B 或 13B 开始，先在 FLAN-v2 上训练一轮，再用 Orca 1 的 5M 条 GPT-3.5 teacher 记录训练三轮，最后用约 1M 条 Orca 1 GPT-4 记录和 817K 条 Orca 2 记录训练四轮，得到 Orca-2-7B 与 13B checkpoint。
  5. 评测学到的策略选择。 在 15 个 benchmark、约 100 个任务和超过 36K 个 prompt 上做 zero-shot 评测，按任务使用 exact match、专用指标或必要的开放式 judge。结果检验模型行为；由于训练记录未发布，不能独立验证隐藏的数据选择决策。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The core matched-size comparison evaluates Orca-2-13B and LLaMA-2-Chat-13B zero-shot on the same reasoning benchmark suite, including AGIEval, BBH, DROP, CRASS, RACE, and GSM8K. Their reasoning macro-averages are 66.92 and 43.71 respectively; Orca-2-7B is also reported as comparable to or better than LLaMA-2-Chat-70B across these reasoning tasks. This supports the full progressive data-and-training recipe for these LLaMA-2 students, but it does not isolate Prompt Erasing from the additional 817K GPT-4 records or the earlier Orca/FLAN stages.

核心同规模对比让 Orca-2-13B 与 LLaMA-2-Chat-13B 在同一套 zero-shot 推理 benchmark 上评测，包括 AGIEval、BBH、DROP、CRASS、RACE 和 GSM8K；两者的推理宏平均分别为 66.92 和 43.71。论文还报告 Orca-2-7B 在这些任务上达到或超过 LLaMA-2-Chat-70B。结果支持这套面向 LLaMA-2 student 的完整渐进数据与训练配方，但不能把 Prompt Erasing 的影响与新增 817K 条 GPT-4 记录、早期 Orca/FLAN 阶段分开。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Orca 1 and other explanation-tuning methods expose the teacher's reasoning instruction together with its answer. Orca 2 changes the training record by selecting a task-appropriate strategy during generation and hiding that strategy prompt from the student. The model must infer when to use the observed behavior from the task itself, making strategy choice part of the learned signal. Teacher-generated explanations and progressive SFT are established; Prompt Erasing plus task-specific strategy mapping is the distinct change.

Orca 1 和其它 explanation-tuning 方法把 teacher 的推理 instruction 与回答一起暴露给 student。Orca 2 改变训练记录：生成时选择适合任务的策略，训练时再向 student 隐藏策略 prompt。模型必须从任务本身推断何时使用所观察到的行为，使策略选择成为学习信号的一部分。Teacher 生成解释和渐进式 SFT 已经存在；Prompt Erasing 与任务专用策略映射才是明确变化。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• No open training data: the 817K Orca 2 records and detailed task-strategy mapping are not released, so provenance, teacher errors, duplicates, and exact prompts cannot be independently audited. Treat the model weights as a behavior artifact, not a reproducible data release.
  • Attribution is confounded: the final model combines FLAN, 5M GPT-3.5 Orca 1, 1M GPT-4 Orca 1, new Orca 2 data, progressive training, and Prompt Erasing. Reuse requires matched ablations before assigning gains to strategy hiding alone.
  • Teacher and judge dependence: GPT-4 can produce plausible but wrong reasoning, and some open-ended evaluations also use model judgment. Add programmatic or human expert checks for target-domain answers and traces.

• 训练数据未开放： 817K 条 Orca 2 记录和详细任务—策略映射没有发布，因此无法独立审计 provenance、teacher 错误、重复项和精确 prompt。模型权重只能视为行为 artifact，不能视为可复现的数据发布。
  • 归因存在混杂： 最终模型结合了 FLAN、5M 条 GPT-3.5 Orca 1、1M 条 GPT-4 Orca 1、新 Orca 2 数据、渐进训练和 Prompt Erasing。复用时要做匹配消融，不能把增益只归因于隐藏策略。
  • 依赖 teacher 与 judge： GPT-4 可能生成看似合理但错误的推理，部分开放式评测也依赖模型判断。目标领域的答案和轨迹应另加程序化检查或专家人工复核。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use Orca 2 when building teacher demonstrations for a smaller model whose best strategy varies by task. Define task groups, choose candidate strategies, elicit several teacher answers, verify them, erase the strategy instruction, and compare against both a generic-explanation dataset and an explicit-strategy-label dataset. The output is a task-answer SFT set plus an auditable hidden mapping. Do not use Prompt Erasing where operators must inspect or control the strategy at inference time, or where teacher answers lack independent correctness checks.

当小模型在不同任务上需要不同策略时，可以用 Orca 2 构建 teacher 示范：先定义任务组和候选策略，为每题生成多份 teacher 回答并验证，再擦除策略 instruction，最后与通用解释数据和显式策略标签数据比较。产物是一套任务—回答 SFT 数据及可审计的隐藏映射。若运行时必须让操作者查看或控制策略，或 teacher 回答没有独立正确性检查，就不应直接使用 Prompt Erasing。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Object: a task plus a GPT-4 answer trace generated under a task-specific strategy prompt.
  • Mechanism: Prompt Erasing removes the strategy instruction before the student sees the record.
  • Scale: 817K new records are trained after FLAN and 6M earlier Orca 1 records.
  • Evidence: Orca-2-13B reaches a 66.92 reasoning macro-average versus 43.71 for LLaMA-2-Chat-13B, with multiple recipe changes combined.
  • Audit: unreleased data, hidden mappings, teacher correctness, overlap, and model-judge dependence are the main blockers to exact reproduction.

• 对象：任务与 GPT-4 回答轨迹，后者由任务专用策略 prompt 生成。
  • 机制：Prompt Erasing 在 student 读取记录前删除策略 instruction。
  • 规模：817K 条新记录在 FLAN 和 6M 条早期 Orca 1 记录之后训练。
  • 证据：Orca-2-13B 的推理宏平均为 66.92，LLaMA-2-Chat-13B 为 43.71，但配方同时改变多项因素。
  • 审计：未公开数据、隐藏映射、teacher 正确性、数据重叠和模型 judge 依赖是精确复现的主要阻碍。
